text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors, Toronto Parking Authority, with an update regarding the Toronto Parking Authority's capital spend for the eight-months ending August 31, 2022 including full-year outlook. As illustrated in Figure1 below, actual capital expenditures August year to date total a modest $3.08 million or 5.6 percent of the capital budget of $54.74 million. However, our capital spend profile is back-end loaded with a projected full-year spend of $29.12 million, which represents 53.2 percent of our original capital plan. Our forecasted variance to plan of $25.6 million (canceled and carry-forward) in 2022 can be attributed to three areas. The first is the cancellation of $3.02 million in projects that are inconsistent with our current state of good repair strategy.
